english.title: Allow premises to be open while subject of a closure order - but licence otherwise in force - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse allowed relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), to be open before the relevant time, following a review of the premises licence by the licensing authority under section 167 of the Licensing Act 2003
english.legislation: Contrary to section 168(8) and (9) of the Licensing Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 168(2) provides that "the relevant time" means the end of the period given for appealing against the decision, or if the decision is appealed against, the time the appeal is disposed of.
